notes: Method limit: WebFetch and curl were blocked for every price host (plasticker, polymerupdate, argusmedia, bpf.co.uk, pieweb - egress proxy 403 / DNS). All figures come from WebSearch result excerpts of the cited URLs; the pages themselves were not opened. Treat as cited-but-unopened.

Polymerupdate article IDs: search excerpts did not always say which listed article a sentence came from; IDs given are the best match by date (1504732 = 21/28 Aug PP + Sep ethylene; 1507188 = 4 Sep LDPE; 1495853 = 14 Aug HDPE; 1485733 = 8 May PVC; 1499687 = July PP contract). Verify the ID before quoting a figure externally.

2026 European commodity resins show an unusually wide gap: spot (PP homo ~EUR 1,190, HDPE blow ~1,130, LDPE ~1,270 EUR/t, Aug-Sep) vs Polymerupdate 'gross contract' (PP inj ~2,000, HDPE film ~2,090, LDPE ~2,540 EUR/t; UK LDPE GBP 2,182/t) vs Business Analytiq indices (PP 1.99, HDPE 1.76, PVC 1.53, PS 1.67 USD/kg) vs EUWID July basket EUR 1,786/t. A UK tier-1 buying from a distributor pays between spot and the EUWID basket; gross-contract lists overstate. A defensible Oct 2026 UK delivered commodity anchor is roughly GBP 1.1-1.5/kg - choose one basis and state it.

Current book vs evidence: mat-pa6 GBP 1.68 vs BA Europe Sep GBP 2.19 (+30%); mat-pa66 GBP 1.89 vs BA GBP 2.55 (+35%) - both look low, single source. mat-pp-homo 0.99 / mat-hdpe 1.05 / mat-ldpe 1.09 sit at spot level (GBP 1.02 / 0.97 / 1.09), below the contract-type indices (1.47 / 1.30). mat-upvc 0.76 below both PVC figures except IMARC Germany June (0.70). mat-abs 1.62 = BA 1.64. mat-pc 2.52 vs IMARC July 2.21. mat-gpps/hips 1.37 vs BA PS 1.23. mat-peek 76 vs global resin US$55-90/kg (GBP 41-67) - possibly high. mat-nr 1.84 below SGX TSR20 FOB GBP 1.90 before freight. mat-cf-dry-3k 25.2 for woven fabric vs fibre ~GBP 25.9 - fabric should exceed fibre.

Not found: LLDPE, PET bottle, POM, PBT, PMMA, PPS, PEI, TPU, TPE/TPV, compound extras (GF/mineral/FR), SBR/EPDM/NBR/CR/FKM, 70 Shore A compound uplift, E-glass, vinyl ester, prepreg, all automotive paints, masterbatch.
